subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should watched-session presence be visible only to recipients authorized to read each referenced session, and should the feature use an explicit active-session signal rather than subscription history before it becomes a shared-gateway UI contract?
rationale: The PR introduces a new disclosure and collaboration-state contract across gateway recipients; the correct permanent policy cannot be selected safely from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Authorize and model active viewing
options.body: Project watched sessions only to read-authorized recipients and add a truthful active-session lifecycle before enabling the facepiles.

options.title: Limit the first release
options.body: Keep identity-only online facepiles and defer per-session viewer state until a recipient-safe active-viewing contract is approved.

options.title: Accept subscription-derived visibility
options.body: Intentionally expose capped subscription history as approximate viewing state, with explicit documentation of its authorization and accuracy tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Authorize and model active viewing
recommendation.body: Project watched sessions only to read-authorized recipients and add a truthful active-session lifecycle before enabling the facepiles.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the merged identity-presence prerequisite and the current extension, and can route the product/security contract to the appropriate owner.
